expected_outcome.description: Block the change: the private-address check in `src/preview/fetch-preview.ts` validates only the first DNS answer for the URL the user gave. `fetch` follows redirects by default and resolves the hostname again when it connects, so a user's https URL that redirects to `http://169.254.169.254/`, or a hostname that re-resolves to it (DNS rebinding), reaches the metadata endpoint, and up to 300 characters of the response are returned to the user. A blocking finding must identify that the check can be bypassed through redirects or re-resolution, and fix it, for example with `redirect: "manual"` and re-validating every hop, connecting to the address that was checked, or an egress proxy that blocks internal ranges.
